priorities.summary: A remote stack-based buffer overflow in the GENA subscription handler of D-Link DIR-600L firmware 2.17b02 lets a remote attacker crash or take over the router, and a public exploit has been released.
priorities.plain: D-Link DIR-600L routers let remote attackers crash or take over the device — replace or retire affected routers.

priorities.summary: An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service (vmdird) of VMware vCenter Server lets anyone with network access gain unauthorized access to vCenter. The flaw was exploited as a zero-day by the Armory Castle group since September 2026, and CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 20 November with a 23 November due date.
priorities.plain: VMware vCenter lets attackers in without logging in — patch now, and check for compromise.

priorities.summary: Unauthenticated privilege escalation in the WordPress plugin Nexter Blocks Pro up to and including 5.0.10: a crafted registration request grants the new account the full Administrator role, giving complete control over the site.
priorities.plain: Nexter Blocks Pro lets anyone sign up as a site administrator — update the plugin immediately.

model.name: Gemini 4 Neon
model.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon on 18 November, a new Gemini 4 model that sits between Hydrogen and Carbon, offering frontier-level reasoning for complex coding, analytical and enterprise work at Flash-like speeds. It is rolling out in the Gemini app for AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and is generally available on the paid Gemini API.
model.plain: A faster top-tier AI assistant for demanding coding and analysis work, now available in Google's paid AI plans.
